scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,server -c green,blue "npm --workspace apps/web run dev" "npm --workspace apps/server run start:dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace packages/shared run build && npm --workspace apps/server run build && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace apps/web run lint && npm --workspace apps/server run lint
scripts.type-check: npm --workspace apps/web run type-check && npm --workspace apps/server run type-check && npm --workspace packages/shared run type-check
